svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
key length 16, added form: fitting pairs on each of 1,000 fresh shuffles (bar at n+1 for n pairs, height on a log scale; the tall first bar = none)
shuffles at or above K4: p 0.00899 (pairs), 0.03796 (distinct cipher alphabets); the 52 cells need p < 0.000962: not a flag
OUT: ONE OF K4'S FIVE FIXED READINGS AT LENGTH 16; THE KNOWN LETTERS ARE IN PLACE BY CONSTRUCTION
